hero.title: Experience Authentic Italian Flavors at PizzaExpress Koramangala
hero.subtitle: From Hand-Tossed Gourmet Pizzas to Decadent Cheesecakes & Fresh Italian Coffee – A Culinary Journey Since 1965.

about.title: Welcome to PizzaExpress Koramangala
about.paragraph1: Step into PizzaExpress Koramangala, your cherished destination for authentic Italian culinary delights in the heart of Bangalore. As a distinguished Pizzeria and Cafe, we've been proudly serving in style since 1965, perfecting the art of Italian gastronomy for generations. We specialize in bringing the vibrant tastes of Italy right to your table, making every visit a memorable experience.
about.paragraph2: Indulge in our signature hand-tossed gourmet Pizzas, each crafted with the freshest ingredients and traditional techniques that define true Italian cooking. Beyond our renowned pizzas, discover the irresistible charm of our mouth-melting, in-house baked cheesecakes and the invigorating aroma of our freshly brewed Italian coffee. At PizzaExpress, every dish is prepared with passion, inviting you to savor timeless flavors and create unforgettable memories.
